heading.en: The hardware that holds a network together

hook.en: Look behind your lab computers: cables with clear plastic plugs, a box with blinking lights, and somewhere a router. Each piece has a specific job.
hook.kn: ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ನೋಡಿ: ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ಪ್ಲಗ್ ಇರುವ ಕೇಬಲ್‌ಗಳು, ಮಿನುಗುವ ದೀಪಗಳ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ, ಎಲ್ಲೋ ಒಂದು ರೂಟರ್. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕೆಲಸವಿದೆ.

objectives.en: State the function of modem, NIC, RJ45, repeater, hub, switch, router and gateway
Distinguish hub from switch and router from gateway

narration.en: Look behind your lab computers: cables with clear plastic plugs, a box with blinking lights, and somewhere a router. Each piece has a specific job.
narration.kn: ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ನೋಡಿ: ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ ಪ್ಲಗ್ ಇರುವ ಕೇಬಲ್‌ಗಳು, ಮಿನುಗುವ ದೀಪಗಳ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ, ಎಲ್ಲೋ ಒಂದು ರೂಟರ್. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕೆಲಸವಿದೆ.

body.en: A modem (modulator–demodulator) converts digital data to analog signals for transmission over telephone or cable lines and back. An Ethernet card or Network Interface Card (NIC) connects a computer to a network; it has the MAC address. RJ45 is an eight-pin jack used to connect Ethernet cables. A repeater regenerates weakened signals, since a signal on an Ethernet cable weakens after about 100 m.

points.en: NIC: network card, holds MAC address

narration.en: A modem converts between digital and analog, the NIC connects a computer to the network, RJ45 is the cable plug, and a repeater boosts weak signals.
narration.kn: ಮೋಡೆಮ್ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್–ಅನಲಾಗ್ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, NIC ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರನ್ನು ಜಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, RJ45 ಕೇಬಲ್ ಪ್ಲಗ್, ರಿಪೀಟರ್ ದುರ್ಬಲ ಸಂಕೇತವನ್ನು ಪುನರುತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: A home network and its devices

say.en: Each computer has a network interface card with its own MAC address. An Ethernet cable plugs in with an RJ45 jack.
A switch joins the computers of a LAN. It sends each frame only to the destination port, using MAC addresses. A hub would send it to every port.
A router connects different networks and forwards packets using IP addresses.
A modem converts digital data to signals for the telephone or cable line, and back. A gateway is the network’s entry and exit, often with a firewall.
On a long cable the signal weakens after about 100 metres; a repeater regenerates it.

narration.en: We build a small network from computers to the Internet and place each network device where it works.

prompt.en: Match each network device with its job.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಜಾಲ ಸಾಧನವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಕೆಲಸದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

right.en: Converts digital data to analog signals for telephone or cable lines, and back
Connects a computer to the network and carries its MAC address
An eight-pin jack at the end of an Ethernet cable
Regenerates a weakened signal so it can travel further
Sends incoming data out of every port
Forwards data only to the port of the destination, using MAC addresses
Connects different networks and forwards packets using IP addresses
Entry and exit point that links networks using different protocols

explanation.en: A hub broadcasts to all ports, a switch picks the right port by MAC address, and a router picks the right network by IP address. A gateway joins networks that follow different protocols.
explanation.kn: ಹಬ್ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪೋರ್ಟ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸ್ವಿಚ್ MAC ವಿಳಾಸದಿಂದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪೋರ್ಟ್, ರೂಟರ್ IP ವಿಳಾಸದಿಂದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಜಾಲ ಆರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A hub connects several computers and sends incoming data to all ports, which wastes bandwidth and causes collisions. A switch also connects computers but forwards data only to the destination port, using MAC addresses. A router connects different networks and forwards packets towards their destination using IP addresses. A gateway is the entry and exit point of a network, connecting it to outside networks that may use different protocols; it often also acts as a firewall.

points.en: Switch: sends only to the destination (MAC)

narration.en: A hub broadcasts to everyone, a switch sends only to the right computer, a router connects different networks, and a gateway is the door to the outside world.
narration.kn: ಹಬ್ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ, ರೂಟರ್ ಬೇರೆ ಜಾಲಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಗೇಟ್‌ವೇ ಹೊರಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಬಾಗಿಲು.

problem.en: A small office has 12 computers and a broadband line. List the devices needed to connect them and the Internet, with the job of each.

steps.en: A NIC in each computer, with Ethernet cables ending in RJ45 connectors.
A 16-port switch to connect the 12 computers into a LAN.
A modem to convert signals on the broadband line.
A router (often combined with the modem) to connect the office LAN to the ISP's network.

answer.en: NICs + RJ45 cables, a switch, a modem and a router.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A small office has 12 computers and a broadband line. List the devices needed to connect them and the Internet, with the job of each.
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two board and CUET pattern questions. Read each one carefully before you answer.
These are CBSE board pattern questions: assertion–reason and case-based. Read the passage or both statements before choosing.

points.en: Modem converts digital ↔ analog; NIC connects a computer.
points.kn: ಮೋಡೆಮ್ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ↔ ಅನಲಾಗ್; NIC ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: RJ45 is the Ethernet connector; a repeater regenerates signals.
points.kn: RJ45 ಎತರ್ನೆಟ್ ಜೋಡಕ; ರಿಪೀಟರ್ ಸಂಕೇತ ಪುನರುತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Hub broadcasts; switch forwards to the destination.
Router joins networks; gateway is the network's entry/exit.
points.kn: ರೂಟರ್ ಜಾಲಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಗೇಟ್‌ವೇ ಜಾಲದ ಪ್ರವೇಶ/ನಿರ್ಗಮನ.

homework.en: Draw your college lab network and label each device.

narration.en: Recap. Modem converts digital ↔ analog; NIC connects a computer. RJ45 is the Ethernet connector; a repeater regenerates signals. Hub broadcasts; switch forwards to the destination. Router joins networks; gateway is the network's entry/exit.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮೋಡೆಮ್ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ↔ ಅನಲಾಗ್; NIC ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. RJ45 ಎತರ್ನೆಟ್ ಜೋಡಕ; ರಿಪೀಟರ್ ಸಂಕೇತ ಪುನರುತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಬ್ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೆ; ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಗಮ್ಯಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ. ರೂಟರ್ ಜಾಲಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಗೇಟ್‌ವೇ ಜಾಲದ ಪ್ರವೇಶ/ನಿರ್ಗಮನ.
